model_annotation: The bar chart illustrates the “effect” values for various language models across different language families. The horizontal axis represents language families, listed alphabetically from “IE-Baltic” to “Uralic,” and the vertical axis displays “effect” values ranging from 0 to approximately 30, marked with linear scale increments. The value axis is labeled “effect” and consists of tick intervals of approximately 5 units. Each bar represents a specific language model, with each bar subdivided into colored segments. The tallest bar, in pale green, corresponds to “mBERT-L2” with an approximate value of 28.  The next tallest bar, in red, represents “mBERT-L2” with an approximate value of 22.  Bars colored blue and grey represent “mBERT-L2” and “XLM-L2” respectively, each with values around 15.  The smallest bar, in dark green, represents “mBERT-R2” with an approximate value of 5.  Bars colored light blue and dark blue represent “XLM-R2” and “mLM-B2” respectively, each with approximate values near 5. Several bars include vertical error bars extending upwards from the center of the bar, representing variability in the “effect” values, and the bars are not sorted in any particular order.
